homepage.feature.easy-to-use.title.description: Title of the `Easy to Use` feature

homepage.feature.easy-to-use.description.message: User-friendliness is paramount: with an intuitive interface, the application simplifies complex tasks such as managing virtual machines and events. The seamless integration of various services ensures that users can work efficiently even with minimal technical knowledge.
homepage.feature.easy-to-use.description.description: Description of the `Easy to Use` feature

homepage.feature.focus-on-what-matters.t.description: Title of the `Focus on What Matters` feature

homepage.feature.focus-on-what-matters.d.message: Focus on the essentials: The versatile application supports a wide range of workflows, from managing virtual environments to handling events and user permissions. Thanks to its modular structure, it can be adapted to different organizational requirements and is therefore suitable for various industries and use cases.
homepage.feature.focus-on-what-matters.d.description: Description of the `Focus on What Matters` feature

homepage.feature.integrates-with-pve.tit.description: Title of the `Integrates with Proxmox VE` feature

homepage.feature.integrates-with-pve.des.message: Integration with Proxmox VE manages the lifecycle of virtual machines and optimizes resource allocation and virtualization. This enables the control of virtual environments for events and courses and significantly simplifies the provisioning and management of VMs.
homepage.feature.integrates-with-pve.des.description: Description of the `Integrates with Proxmox VE` feature

homepage.feature.build-with-fastapi.titl.description: Title of the `Built with FastAPI on Python 3` feature

homepage.feature.build-with-fastapi.desc.message: Developed with Python 3 and FastAPI, the backend provides a powerful REST API for managing services and data. Using SQLAlchemy for database interactions and Pydantic for data validation, it ensures robust handling of complex business logic and user input.
homepage.feature.build-with-fastapi.desc.description: Description of the `Built with FastAPI on Python 3` feature

homepage.feature.build-with-vuejs.title.description: Title of the `Built with Vue.js` feature

homepage.feature.build-with-vuejs.descri.message: The frontend is based on Vue.js 3 and uses reactive components and the Composition API for efficient state management and dynamic user interfaces. This modern framework enables a smooth, responsive experience and integrates seamlessly with OpenVLE's backend services to display real-time data and user interactions.
homepage.feature.build-with-vuejs.descri.description: Description of the `Built with Vue.js` feature

homepage.feature.integrates-with-guacamo.description: Title of the `Integrates with Apache Guacamole` feature

homepage.feature.integrates-with-guacamo.message: The connection to Apache Guacamole enables seamless remote access to virtual machines via browser-based connections. Users can easily connect to VMs without the need for additional software by using pre-configured connection profiles managed by the system.
homepage.feature.integrates-with-guacamo.description: Description of the `Integrates with Apache Guacamole` feature
